Planning a special weekend meal for your partner? Here’s a delicious 3-course menu you can make right at home! Start with crispy Palak Cutlets, followed by a wholesome Kodo Millet Buddha Bowl with Spicy Chickpeas & Tofu, and finish with a rich and airy Chocolate Soufflé.
Simple ingredients, restaurant-style flavours and a complete meal for two — perfect for a cozy weekend or a special date night at home.
Best cooked in Wonderchef Kitchenware.
